epistemic_policy: Every discovered record remains CANDIDATE_UNREVIEWED until human review.
Model-generated synthesis, classifications, embeddings, inferred entities and reasoning chains are not evidence.
Similarity does not imply historical descent, common origin or diffusion.
Publication, version, index, release/update and discovery dates remain distinct.
Archaeological observations remain distinct from inferred symbolic, ritual, social or cognitive meaning.
Ancient-DNA affinity, mtDNA haplogroup, culture, language, technology and social identity are not interchangeable variables.

new_candidates.title: Rhythmicity and Trait Absorption Are Linked to Nonordinary States of Consciousness
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: 27 participants completed rhythmic and non-rhythmic drumming conditions with EEG and phenomenology measures; rhythmicity affected some unity/spiritual-experience measures while entrainment strength did not explain NSC phenomenology.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Small modern sample cannot establish prehistoric trance, shamanism, ritual function, historical continuity or a universal neural mechanism; exploratory absorption moderation requires caution.

provenance.publisher: Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences / Wiley

new_candidates.title: Isotope analysis reveals mobility of the earliest cattle herds in northern Europe
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Strontium, oxygen and carbon isotopes from Swifterbant S3/S4 livestock identify non-local animals and repeated movement, consistent with animal-transfer networks.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Animal movement is not direct observation of human migration, ancestry, ethnicity, language or cultural transmission.

new_candidates.title: The European Upper Palaeolithic Palaeoecological and Archaeological Dataset for sites north of 50°N
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: FAIR dataset covering 803 sites north of 50°N, c.47,000-14,000 cal BP, with 636 variables including 538 palaeoecological variables, contexts, artefacts, fauna/flora and radiocarbon metadata.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Environmental co-occurrence is not causation or adaptation. Source quality and chronology are heterogeneous; NA is intentionally preserved where absence cannot be established.

new_candidates.title: PaleoHumans — European Upper Palaeolithic Homo sapiens Remains
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Current v1.0.0 reports 812 individuals, 4,616 bone remains, 106 skeletons and 250 sites with chronology and mortuary fields.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Mortuary activity is broader than funerary/ritual behavior. Sex, cultural phase, burial status and identity remain distinct. Chronological reclassifications require record-level reconciliation.

dating_change.scope: Prior Late Pleistocene assignments reported revised to Mesolithic, Roman, Medieval/Modern or Middle Pleistocene/Palaeolithic; candidate reconciliation only.

new_candidates.title: AmtDB — Ancient mtDNA database, 2026-08-11 update
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: 2026-08-11 update reports 1,211 new samples, 982 complete mitogenomes, plus a PCA beta and downloadable sequence/metadata records.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: mtDNA haplogroup frequencies/PCA are matrilineal summaries, not whole-genome ancestry, population identity, culture, language, ethnicity or migration truth.

new_candidates.title: Invisible East Digital Corpus: JSON Dataset, Version 1.2
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Open JSON export of medieval Afghanistan and surrounding-region documents with high-resolution images, expert transcriptions and translations across Persian, Arabic, Bactrian, Sogdian and other languages.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Surviving texts are not population prevalence measures; transcription, translation, genre and archival survival remain source-specific and text content does not establish private belief.

new_candidates.title: Reassessing the Early Neolithic Chronology of La Marmotta lakeshore settlement
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: 35 radiocarbon determinations, including 22 new dates, Bayesian modeling and ceramic reassessment revise La Marmotta's internal chronology and pressure the traditional sequential ceramic-phase interpretation.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: The model does not automatically rewrite every object/context date; sample-context integrity and model assumptions remain review requirements.

dating_change.scope: La Marmotta internal occupation sequence; human review required before NOEMA chronology changes.

new_candidates.title: PREMOVE – A diachronic dataset of Ancient Greek and Latin annotated PREverbed MOtion VErbs
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Manually annotated 2,835 Ancient Greek and Latin preverbed motion-verb occurrences with morphology, syntax, semantics, geography, genre, century and language-period metadata.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Linguistic constructions do not directly encode ancestry, population movement, identity, belief or cultural descent.

provenance.provider: Oxford Text Archive / Zenodo / King's College London

contradictions_and_method_pressure.finding: Rhythmicity affected some phenomenology, while entrainment strength did not explain NSC phenomenology.
Livestock mobility does not directly measure human migration or cultural transmission.
NA/unknown must not become absence; environmental association is not causation.
Several former Late Pleistocene attributions are now chronologically reclassified.
mtDNA haplogroup/PCA structure must not be equated with culture, language or whole-population ancestry.
Historical texts and translations are not direct population-wide prevalence measures.
New radiocarbon/Bayesian evidence pressures the traditional ceramic-phase succession.
Diachronic linguistic patterns remain distinct from ancestry, migration and identity.

summary: Latest NOEMA Discovery returned 107 unreviewed Crossref candidates and 30 priority items (5 recent, 2 upcoming/ahead-of-print, 23 newly indexed legacy), with the priority queue unchanged from 2026-09-13. Eight additional material candidates were staged after DOI/authoritative-ID/canonical-URL deduplication. No candidate was promoted to evidence and no historical relationships were generated.
